The '''Sophouse''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Toward the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], two individuals discussed how they believed the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was dying out in the galaxy.
